agent_explanation: Body with e~0.998 collides with thin vertical wall (0.3x5.2 at x=14.5). Despite near-elastic, kinetic energy increases from ~904.8J to ~941.2J after wall bounce (steps 12-20). Later ceiling bounce at step 62->63 increases energy from 988.15J to 1002.99J, exceeding E0+10%+5 limit 1000.31. Suggests collision impulse/positional correction double-counts in substep loop when restitution ~1, producing super-elastic restitution >1.
